title: RONALDO'S GOAL OR AN OWN GOAL? THE LEAGUE AND OPTA DISAGREE
description:
Who scored it? Depends who you ask, and the record books don't agree.

This October the league credited Cristiano Ronaldo with a goal. Opta logged it as an own goal. A goal with two owners.

It fits a career that has never been quiet. His first Champions League game for Juventus ended with a red card. At the 2006 World Cup came the Rooney incident, then a season of boos. At school he was expelled, and by his own account he threw a chair at a teacher.

Yet he has 35 trophies and once scored 17 Champions League goals in a single season. Not bad for an expelled student. Now he's up for Best Middle East Player again, and he won it last time. Keep the chairs on the floor.

So settle it: goal or own goal? Who gets the credit, the league or Opta? Tell us below.
